runtime.action.done.note: What the user did with an action a question offered (#1630), as its answer's wake says it.

runtime.action.noCode.note: What the user did with an action a question offered (#1630), as its answer's wake says it.

runtime.action.skipReview.note: What the user did with an action a question offered (#1630), as its answer's wake says it.

runtime.action.unblock.note: What the user did with an action a question offered (#1630), as its answer's wake says it.

runtime.choice.accept.note: The user's choice at a lane's round limit, as its answer's wake says it.

runtime.choice.carryOn.note: The user's choice at a lane's round limit, as its answer's wake says it.

runtime.choice.split.note: The user's choice at a lane's round limit, as its answer's wake says it.

runtime.choice.takeOver.note: The user's choice at a lane's round limit, as its answer's wake says it.

runtime.forward.resolving.text: Ended here, nothing merged: Resolve on a builder made {card} for a builder to merge {from} ({source}) into {to} and resolve the conflict there. Follow {card}.
runtime.forward.resolving.note: HI-2959: the comment on a forward merge card (Combwork merging branch {from} into {to}) ended by Resolve on a builder. {card}: the new card’s key; {source}: a short commit id.

runtime.move.doneByOverride.text: {cards} can start without {card}'s work in the target: it is Done by an override, not merged.
runtime.move.doneByOverride.note: A move's warning: cards waiting on this one can start, but its work isn't in their target. {cards}: their keys.

runtime.repair.boardDone.text: the board had it in Done while its stage was {stage}
runtime.repair.boardDone.note: A repair's reason, stored on the card's Moved fact: the board's column and the card's stage disagreed. {stage}: the stage id.

runtime.review.everyTest.note: Why the focused-test picker couldn't choose: it named every test.

runtime.review.focusedChosenBy.text: its builder, as its picker couldn't choose ({why}): check they cover the change
runtime.review.focusedChosenBy.note: G20 (HI-1367): start review's focusedChosenBy, when the builder named the focused tests itself. {why}: the picker's reason (runtime.review.everyTest, or its own words).

runtime.review.pickFailed.note: Why the focused-test picker couldn't choose, when it gave no reason.

runtime.review.runYourself.text: {tests}: the merge queue doesn't run these (a real CLI or the installed app); each counts from your run at this revision, cw-progress --check "{check}" --card <card> -- <its command>, or from another's run of it there that your pass accepts (cw_verdict's accept)
runtime.review.runYourself.note: G20 (HI-1367): start review's runYourself: focused tests the merge queue won't run, which count only from the reviewer's own run. {tests}: their ids. {check}: the check's name pattern (focused:<test>).

runtime.start.blocked.note: A start's warning: the card is blocked. {why}: the block's reason, in its author's words.

runtime.start.laneStarted.text: Combwork started {card} for you, as your lane's next card: carry on with it.
runtime.start.laneStarted.note: HI-2092: a lane's builder starting the card Combwork had already started for it: its start's warning.

runtime.start.moreFiles.note: HI-2944: a list of paths cut at three, and how many more there are.

runtime.start.slotMove.text: You'll continue in {slot}, on {line}: Combwork makes the line there from {target}, then gives you {card} there (a new conversation unless you already work there; your old one is kept). End your turn now.
runtime.start.slotMove.note: A start given a slot (#1438): the card's line is made there and the card given to the agent there, so it ends its turn now.

runtime.start.slotWait.note: A start's warning beside its refusal (#1438): why no slot is free.

runtime.start.targetChanges.text: {target}'s folder {folder} has uncommitted changes ({files}): a merge into {target} that changes them pauses until they are committed or set aside. Combwork tells the user in its window; leave them as they are.
runtime.start.targetChanges.note: HI-2944: a start's warning (never a refusal): the folder the target is checked out in has uncommitted changes; the user's window shows a notification with Commit and Set Aside. {files}: up to three paths, then how many more.

runtime.submit.movedAhead.text: moved ahead of {cards} (not started); its reviewer is told
runtime.submit.movedAhead.note: A submit's lane field: the card was moved before its lane's cards nobody has started. {cards}: their keys.

runtime.submit.pathsLeaveOut.text: {card}'s paths leave out files it recorded as its agents' edits: {files}. Its revision covers only its paths: to include them, submit with paths listing every file of its work (or declare its paths); to leave them out, carry on.
runtime.submit.pathsLeaveOut.note: A submit's warning (HI-2339): files its agents edited that its declared paths leave out. {files}: those files.

runtime.submit.unclaimed.text: Changed in the project since {card} started, in neither its paths nor what it recorded as its agents' edits: {files}. Not part of its revision: to include any, submit with paths listing every file of its work; else leave them.
runtime.submit.unclaimed.note: A submit's warning (HI-2339): files changed in the project that are neither its paths nor its agents' edits.

runtime.verdict.acceptFailed.text: accept: {test}'s latest counted run at this revision failed, so it isn't accepted
runtime.verdict.acceptFailed.note: HI-2660: the standing run of focused:<test> at the passed revision didn't pass; an earlier pass never stands behind it. {test}: the test id.

runtime.verdict.acceptInvalid.text: accept: {test} isn't a test id, so it isn't accepted
runtime.verdict.acceptInvalid.note: HI-2660: an accept entry that isn't a valid focused test id. {test}: what was given, quoted, short.

runtime.verdict.acceptNone.text: accept: {test} has no counted run at this revision (or its command changed since), so it isn't accepted
runtime.verdict.acceptNone.note: HI-2660: no standing run of focused:<test> at the passed revision to accept. {test}: the test id.

runtime.verdict.acceptOnPass.text: accept is taken only with a pass: nothing accepted
runtime.verdict.acceptOnPass.note: HI-2660: cw_verdict's accept given with a fail. Agent-facing.

runtime.verdict.acceptTooMany.text: accept: only the first {max} tests are taken
runtime.verdict.acceptTooMany.note: HI-2660: more than ACCEPT_MAX tests in cw_verdict's accept. {max}: the limit.

runtime.wake.aheadInLane.text: {card} is in Review ahead of {cards}, earlier in its lane, which nobody has started: Combwork moved it before them in the lane. Review {card} now; the lane goes on to {next} after it
runtime.wake.aheadInLane.note: The reviewer's wake for a card submitted ahead of its lane's unstarted cards. {cards}: their keys. {next}: the first of them.

runtime.wake.answered.text: {card}: the user {answer, select, approved {approved} declined {declined} other {answered}} "{question}"
runtime.wake.answered.note: An answer's wake: what the user did with a question. {answer}: approved, declined or another answer. {question}: the question, quoted short (#1626); what they chose or noted follows.

runtime.wake.answered.action.note: An answer's wake with the action the user took (#1630). {action}: runtime.action.*.

runtime.wake.answered.choice.note: An answer's wake with the user's choice at the round limit. {said}: runtime.wake.answered. {choice}: runtime.choice.*.

runtime.wake.answered.note.note: An answer's action with the user's note: {note}, in their words.

runtime.wake.answered.rounds.text: {said} ({rounds, plural, one {{rounds} more round} other {{rounds} more rounds}})
runtime.wake.answered.rounds.note: {said}: the answer and its choice. {rounds}: the rounds the user gave.

runtime.wake.answered.with.note: An answer's wake with the user's reply: {note}, in their words.

runtime.wake.approvedMerge.text: approved: merge it and report the merge
runtime.wake.approvedMerge.note: The builder's wake when its card passed and the builder merges it.

runtime.wake.byDecision.text: {card}: the user answered {questions} with a decision (recorded by {recordedBy}): {decision}
runtime.wake.byDecision.note: {questions}: the questions, each quoted short, joined by runtime.wake.byDecision.and. {recordedBy}: who recorded it. {decision}: its text.

runtime.wake.byDecision.and.note: The questions a decision answered, joined: each one added to the list before it.

runtime.wake.failedReview.note: The builder's wake for a failing verdict.

runtime.wake.focusedSkip.text: {card}: its reviewer {merge, select, yes {accepted} other {declined}} the focused tests its merge skipped ({why})
runtime.wake.focusedSkip.note: The builder's wake for its reviewer's cw_focused_skip. {merge}: yes when it accepted. {why}: the reviewer's reason.

runtime.wake.followUp.text: {card}: follow-up submitted for review at {revision} (submission {submission}). Start your review again (cw_start_review), which takes it and moves your review copy to it; a verdict on the earlier submission is refused
runtime.wake.followUp.note: HI-1832: the reviewer's wake for a follow-up (the card stays in Review, so no arrival wakes it). {revision}: short. {submission}: its number.

runtime.wake.inReview.note: The reviewer's wake for a card's arrival in Review.

runtime.wake.laneListChanged.text: Your lane's card list changed, as queued: its cards are now {cards}. cw_lane next names your next card.
runtime.wake.laneListChanged.note: A lane's builder's wake when its queued list applied. {cards}: the keys, in order.

runtime.wake.newDecision.note: The builder's (and a reviewing reviewer's) wake for a decision the user recorded on the card.

runtime.wake.questionDone.text: {card}: your question "{question}" no longer stands: the card is in Done.
runtime.wake.questionDone.note: An asker's wake when the card reached Done with its question open. {question}: the question, quoted short (#1626).

runtime.wake.removed.text: {card} was taken out of the merge queue by {by, select, user {the user} other {the Assistant}}{reason}. It isn't merged; it is queued again only if the user retries it or it is approved again.
runtime.wake.removed.note: The builder's wake for a card taken out of the queue. {by}: user or assistant. {reason}: ": " and the reason, or nothing.

runtime.wake.reviewerAsks.note: #912: the builder's wake for its reviewer's request mid-review. {text}: the request, in the reviewer's words.

runtime.wake.squashed.text: {line} is up to date with {target} ({prev} was squashed into it): {next} can start.
runtime.wake.squashed.note: A builder's wake when its next card's line was moved onto the target after a squash merge. {prev}: the card squashed, {next}: the card that can start.

runtime.wake.stale.note: The builder's wake when its pass went stale at the verdict (its line moved).

runtime.wake.stalePaths.text: stale: your paths changed since the pass, submit again
runtime.wake.stalePaths.note: The builder's wake when its declared paths changed after its pass.
